newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Irish bourse down as several leading stocks sag.
newsitem.headline: Irish bourse down as several leading stocks sag.

text.p: The Irish bourse weakened in thin late trade on Wednesday as several leading stocks sagged in lacklustre activity, dealers said.
"Things are quiet," one dealer said. "There was a bit of CRH stock available which pushed its price down but there was weakness all round really."
By 1750 GMT the ISEQ index of shares shed 9.12 points from Tuesday's close to 2630.84.
Among the leading financial stocks, AIB and Bank of Ireland both eased one penny to 384 and 496 pence respectively.
